list.title: The studio's games.
list.lede: Three games, three worlds, nothing to install. Each one opens in a browser tab, on desktop and mobile alike, and each has its own page: trailer, screenshots, technical challenge and playable demo.
list.moreText: Patch notes, devlogs and demos: the rest happens in the news and in the Nest.

gallery.hint: Click to enlarge, arrow keys to navigate.

news.more: The next {game} patch notes and devlogs will land in the studio news.

rollback.title: ROLLBACK, FRAME BY FRAME
rollback.intro: In this demo you play the opponent. The hit you send takes a few frames to cross the network: in the meantime, the game bets on no input at all. When the real input arrives, it rewinds, corrects and replays. At full speed, nothing shows.

status.ok: Frame {frame} · 60 Hz · prediction was right, nothing to redo
status.good: {frames} frames replayed in {ms} ms. Invisible to the naked eye.

iconic.title: Mini game
iconic.intro: Find the historical figure tied to this image. Three tries, not one more. Every step that fires lights up in the state machine, just like in the game.
iconic.triesLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No tries left} one {# try left} other {# tries left}}
iconic.machineLabel: Current state of the state machine
iconic.hint: Missed. Free hint for the demo: {hint}. In the game, it costs 100 ICoins and breaks the streak.
iconic.lost: It was {name}. Streak reset, the card will come back later.

screw.alt: Iconic card: an aerial screw made of wood and canvas, standing on a base of sand
screw.question: Who does this odd machine belong to?
screw.name: Leonardo da Vinci
screw.hint: a Renaissance genius, painter and inventor

elephant.alt: Iconic card: a war elephant carrying two soldiers, on snowy ground
elephant.question: Next card: who took this across the mountains?
elephant.name: Hannibal
elephant.hint: a Carthaginian general who crossed the Alps

bicorne.alt: Iconic card: a black bicorne hat with a tricolour cockade
bicorne.question: And this hat, whose is it?
bicorne.name: Napoleon

fastr.title: > TRY A PENALTY
fastr.intro: Theme: Pokémon. Type a name, press Enter to submit. Matching tolerates accents and small typos (“pikatchu” goes through). Then switch a penalty on and try again.

none.name: No penalty
none.text: No active penalty. It never lasts.

wall.name: Brick wall
wall.text: Brick wall: 4 characters max. Only short names are left (Mew, Abra, Onix).

freeze.name: Brain freeze
freeze.text: Brain freeze: every keystroke lands 650 ms late.

clouds.name: Creeping clouds
clouds.text: Creeping clouds: no way to see the words already validated.

fastr.unknown: “{word}” is not in the demo dictionary (about twenty first-generation Pokémon).
fastr.duplicate: {word} is already validated: a word only counts once per game.
fastr.validTypo: {word} validated: 100 points + {bonus} speed bonus. Typo forgiven.
